# Compiler-produced classfile controls

These small classfiles were compiled from the paired sources, not assembled by the decoder under
test. `hashes.json` records the exact inputs. Tests read bytes only; no JVM or compiler is needed.

`pluginfixture/Person.class`, `Model.class`, `Model$Companion.class`, and `Model$$serializer.class`
come from the disposable project generated by `dev/compiler_plugin_project.lua`: Gradle 8.10.2,
Kotlin 1.9.23, serialization compiler plugin 1.9.23/runtime 1.6.3, Lombok 1.18.32, JDK 17, JVM target
17. To regenerate the same declarations outside the checkout:

```sh
nvim -l dev/compiler_plugin_project.lua /new/temporary/plugin-project
cd /new/temporary/plugin-project
./gradlew classes
javap -p -s -v build/classes/java/main/pluginfixture/Person.class
javap -p -s -v 'build/classes/kotlin/main/pluginfixture/Model$Companion.class'
```

Copy only the four named classfiles. `sources/pluginfixture/` preserves their source inputs.
Person's generated getter is an instance method. The serializer method belongs to the companion,
not Model, and its erased descriptor and generic Signature are separate facts. Synthetic and
bridge methods remain in the binary inventory without automatically becoming editor candidates.

`noarg-{off,on}/NeedsLabel.class` come from `sources/noargfixture/NeedsLabel.kt`, Kotlin's embeddable
compiler 1.9.23, JDK 17, JVM target 17. Set `COMPILER_CP` to the compiler's runtime dependencies and
`STDLIB` to kotlin-stdlib 1.9.23, then run each command into a new external output directory:

```sh
java -cp "$COMPILER_CP" org.jetbrains.kotlin.cli.jvm.K2JVMCompiler \
  -no-stdlib -no-reflect -jvm-target 17 -classpath "$STDLIB" \
  -d /tmp/noarg-off sources/noargfixture/NeedsLabel.kt
java -cp "$COMPILER_CP" org.jetbrains.kotlin.cli.jvm.K2JVMCompiler \
  -no-stdlib -no-reflect -jvm-target 17 -classpath "$STDLIB" \
  -Xplugin=/path/to/kotlin-noarg-compiler-plugin-embeddable-1.9.23.jar \
  -P plugin:org.jetbrains.kotlin.noarg:annotation=noargfixture.GenerateNoArg \
  -d /tmp/noarg-on sources/noargfixture/NeedsLabel.kt
```

The compiler runtime dependencies used were kotlin-compiler-embeddable 1.9.23, kotlin-stdlib 1.9.23,
kotlin-reflect 1.6.10, kotlin-script-runtime 1.9.23, trove4j 1.0.20200330, and annotations 13.0. Use
the platform's classpath separator. Independent javac controls accepted `new NeedsLabel()` only
with the plugin enabled; kotlinc rejected `NeedsLabel()` both times. The generated public zero-arg
constructor is **not synthetic** in these artifacts. Flags alone therefore cannot establish Kotlin
source callability.

`unicodefixture/名前.class` was generated with JDK 21.0.3 javac using
`javac -encoding UTF-8 --release 17 -g:none -d /tmp/unicode sources/unicodefixture/名前.java`.
It covers Unicode declaration names/descriptors and modified UTF-8 string constants containing
NUL and a supplementary character. The decoder does not interpret the constant's value.

The decoder is a metadata reader, not a JVM verifier, compiler-producer closure proof, or an editor
integration. SourceFile attributes are filename hints, never fabricated source ranges. Freshness,
module visibility, language-specific callability, and source mappings require separate evidence.

## Ordinary Java array methods

`arrayfixture/{Factory,Item}.class` were emitted by Oracle JDK 17.0.7 javac, using
the complete paired sources in `sources/arrayfixture/`. The root-owned compiler
also accepted the complete Java binary-only consumer and rejected the three invalid
Object/array member calls. These controls do not prove whole-library completeness.

Regenerate into an empty directory outside the checkout:

```sh
mkdir -p /new/temp/empty /new/temp/array
javac --release 17 -encoding UTF-8 -proc:none -sourcepath "" \
  -classpath /new/temp/empty -d /new/temp/array \
  sources/arrayfixture/Factory.java sources/arrayfixture/Item.java
javap -p -s -v /new/temp/array/arrayfixture/Factory.class
```

`hashes.json` records the actual classfiles and both sources. The decoder tests
separate array rank, primitive components, generic Signature and annotations.
Shared compiled-method projection admits the verified public nongeneric zero-argument
instance array returns; unsupported methods remain unknown. Binary-only library stubs
supply positive method facts with Stub provenance, never original source locations
or a proof that other members are absent.

## Requires-only module controls

`module-only/` contains 19 small classfiles (3,431 bytes total). Five are exact
`META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class` entries extracted from the published binary JARs:

| Artifact | Versions |
| --- | --- |
| `org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk7` | 1.8.21, 2.4.0 |
| `org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8` | 1.8.21, 2.4.0 |
| `org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-jdk8` | 1.11.0 |

The matching source-JAR declarations are preserved in `sources/module-only/<artifact-version>/`.
The upstream projects are [Kotlin](https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin) and
[kotlinx.coroutines](https://github.com/Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines), copyright JetBrains and their
contributors, licensed under Apache 2.0. `module-only/LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt` preserves that license.
`module-only/provenance.json` records the exact binary/source Maven URLs and SHA256 values, each
classfile's SHA256, and the independent JDK 17 `ModuleDescriptor.read` result. To recover the five
exact published classfiles, download those hash-pinned JARs and extract the named entry without
recompiling or modifying it. Whole binary JAR controls are separately preserved under
`crates/ktlsp/tests/fixtures/module-only/`.

The other inputs start from these repository-authored sources, compiled separately with javac 17:

```sh
javac --release 17 -d /new/temp/module sources/module-only/javac/module-info.java
javac --release 17 -d /new/temp/ordinary sources/module-only/javac/Plain.java sources/module-only/javac/Empty.java
```

`javac-empty-module.class` is the emitted module descriptor; `ordinary-as-module-info.class` and
`zero-member-interface.class` are the unmodified `Plain.class` and `Empty.class`, with fixture
filenames chosen to defeat filename/header-only classification. The remaining mutations of the
module descriptor are listed below. Offsets refer to the parsed class header or Module payload,
not fixed byte positions. Update outer attribute lengths/counts when changing payloads.

| Fixture | Mutation |
| --- | --- |
| `wrong-class-flags` | Replace class flags with zero. |
| `extra-class-flags` | Replace class flags with `0x8001`. |
| `old-class-version` | Set major version to 52. |
| `invalid-module-name-index` | Set Module's name index to zero. |
| `wrong-module-name-tag` | Set Module's name index to the header's Class index. |
| `zero-requires-version` | Set the first requires-version index to zero (valid). |
| `forged-module-class-name` | Replace the UTF8 `module-info` with `module-infX`. |
| `invalid-empty-module-payload` | Remove the complete Module payload. |
| `invalid-module-payload-trailing` | Append a zero byte inside the Module payload. |
| `duplicate-module-attribute` | Append a second copy of the Module attribute. |
| `truncated-module` | Remove the classfile's last byte. |

The independent JDK oracle accepted seven inputs and rejected twelve; all 160 strict prefixes of
the javac module descriptor were also rejected. The requires-only helper deliberately supports a
smaller subset than the JVM: versions 53–61, requires flags observed in these artifacts, zero
exports/opens/uses/provides, SourceFile, and generic zero-pair marker annotations. Other shapes stay
inconclusive. In particular, legal zero version indexes must work, while trailing payload bytes
must not become an emptiness proof. Tests need no installed JVM. This classification establishes
ordinary declaration absence for a verified selected artifact; it supplies no module graph or
compiler-plugin closure proof.

## Ordinary Java binary constants

`gradle8142/JavaCompilerArgumentsBuilder.class` is the unchanged entry
`org/gradle/api/internal/tasks/compile/JavaCompilerArgumentsBuilder.class` from
the original Gradle8.14.2 binary distribution's `gradle-language-java-8.14.2.jar`.
The full upstream8.14.2 source is paired in `sources/gradle8142/`; its original
Apache2 license notice is retained. This fixture was not rebuilt for these tests.
Both `USE_UNSHARED_COMPILER_TABLE_OPTION` and `EMPTY_SOURCE_PATH_REF_DIR` are
public static final String declarations in that source and in the distributed
class. Constant values are not interpreted or fabricated by analysis stubs.
Tests check field metadata and Java/Kotlin positive completion, not source
navigation, compiler-plugin support, enum completeness or negative closure.
Independent whole Java/Kotlin consumer compilation remains a separate control.


## Field-only public member fixture

fieldfixture/FieldOnly.class is actual Oracle javac17.0.7 output from the paired
sources/fieldfixture/FieldOnly.java. Reproduce with javac --release 17 -encoding
UTF-8 -g:source -d OUTPUT sources/fieldfixture/FieldOnly.java. It contains public static-final String LABEL and public int
count, with only the implicit constructor. Native class size272B, major61,
SHAbfaf22b97a5e004a9bbf6f50033ae27ddac0097249f93c02d11c5f36e319025d.
It guards Property-only local/Module publication and Java/Kotlin cold/warm
completion; it does not establish source closure or constant-value semantics.
